+  --git-repos                list root of git-tree status
+  --git-repos-no-status      list each git-repos branch name (much faster)
+    
+"""
+
+
+ICON_EXT = {
+    ".c": "", ".cpp": "", ".css": "", ".go": "", ".html": "",
+    ".java": "", ".js": "", ".md": "", ".php": "", ".py": "",
+    ".rb": "", ".rs": "", ".sh": "", ".svg": "󰕙", ".png": "",
+    ".jpg": "", ".jpeg": "", ".gif": "", ".webp": "", ".toml": "",
+    ".json": "", ".yml": "", ".yaml": "", ".lock": "", ".txt": "󰈙",
+}
+
+
+SORT_ALIASES = {
+    "name": "name", "filename": "name", "Name": "Name", "Filename": "Name",
+    "extension": "extension", "ext": "extension", "Extension": "Extension", "Ext": "Extension",
+    "size": "size", "type": "type", "created": "created", "modified": "modified",
+    "changed": "changed", "accessed": "accessed", "date": "modified", "time": "modified",
+    "old": "old", "oldest": "old", "new": "new", "newest": "new", "age": "modified",
+    "inode": "inode", "none": "none",
+}
+
+
+class EzaError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, code=3):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.code = code
+
+
+class Opts:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.paths = []
+        self.long = False
+        self.grid = False
+        self.oneline = False
+        self.tree = False
+        self.recurse = False
+        self.across = False
+        self.all_count = 0
+        self.almost_all = False
+        self.treat_dirs = False
+        self.list_dirs = False
+        self.only_dirs = False
+        self.only_files = False
+        self.show_symlinks = False
+        self.no_symlinks = False
+        self.level = None
+        self.reverse = False
+        self.sort = "name"
+        self.dirs_first = False
+        self.dirs_last = False
+        self.ignore = []
+        self.icons = "auto"
+        self.color = "auto"
+        self.classify = "auto"
+        self.width = None
+        self.absolute = False
+        self.absolute_mode = "on"
+        self.follow_symlinks = False
+        self.no_quotes = False
+        self.hyperlink = False
+        self.binary = False
+        self.bytes = False
+        self.header = False
+        self.links = False
+        self.inode = False
+        self.blocksize = False
+        self.octal = False
+        self.no_permissions = False
+        self.no_filesize = False
+        self.no_user = False
+        self.no_time = False
+        self.group = False
+        self.smart_group = False
+        self.numeric = False
+        self.time_field = "modified"
+        self.time_style = "default"
+        self.stdin = False
+        self.git = False
+        self.no_git = False
+        self.git_repos = False
+        self.git_repos_no_status = False
+
+
+def usage_error(msg):
+    raise EzaError(f"eza: {msg}\n", 3)
+
+
+def need_value(argv, i, opt):
+    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
+        usage_error(f"Option {opt} needs a value")
+    return argv[i + 1], i + 1
+
+
+def set_when(name, value):
+    if value not in ("always", "auto", "never"):
+        usage_error(f"Invalid value for option {name}: {value}")
+    return value
+
+
+def parse(argv):
+    opts = Opts()
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if arg == "--":
+            opts.paths.extend(argv[i + 1:])
+            break
+        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
+            opts.paths.append(arg)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            nameval = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in nameval:
+                name, val = nameval.split("=", 1)
+                has_val = True
+            else:
+                name, val, has_val = nameval, None, False
+            def val_or_next(default=None, required=False):
+                nonlocal i, val, has_val
+                if has_val:
+                    return val
+                if required:
+                    val, i = need_value(argv, i, "--" + name)
+                    return val
+                if default is not None:
+                    return default
+                return None
+            if name in ("help",):
+                sys.stdout.write(HELP); raise SystemExit(0)
+            if name in ("version",):
+                sys.stdout.write(VERSION); raise SystemExit(0)
+            if name in ("oneline",): opts.oneline = True
+            elif name == "long": opts.long = True
+            elif name == "grid": opts.grid = True
+            elif name == "across": opts.across = True
+            elif name == "recurse": opts.recurse = True
+            elif name == "tree": opts.tree = True; opts.recurse = True
+            elif name == "dereference": pass
+            elif name == "classify": opts.classify = set_when("--classify", val_or_next("auto"))
+            elif name in ("color", "colour"): opts.color = set_when("--" + name, val_or_next("auto"))
+            elif name in ("color-scale", "colour-scale"): val_or_next("all")
+            elif name in ("color-scale-mode", "colour-scale-mode"): val_or_next(required=True)
+            elif name == "icons": opts.icons = set_when("--icons", val_or_next("auto"))
+            elif name == "no-quotes": opts.no_quotes = True
+            elif name == "hyperlink": opts.hyperlink = True
+            elif name == "absolute":
+                opts.absolute = True; opts.absolute_mode = val_or_next("on")
+                if opts.absolute_mode not in ("on", "follow", "off"): usage_error(f"Invalid value for option --absolute: {opts.absolute_mode}")
+                if opts.absolute_mode == "off": opts.absolute = False
+            elif name == "follow-symlinks": opts.follow_symlinks = True
+            elif name == "width": opts.width = int(val_or_next(required=True))
+            elif name == "all": opts.all_count += 1
+            elif name == "almost-all": opts.almost_all = True
+            elif name == "treat-dirs-as-files": opts.treat_dirs = True
+            elif name == "list-dirs": opts.list_dirs = True; opts.treat_dirs = True
+            elif name == "level": opts.level = int(val_or_next(required=True))
+            elif name == "reverse": opts.reverse = True
+            elif name == "sort": opts.sort = parse_sort(val_or_next(required=True))
+            elif name == "ignore-glob": opts.ignore.extend(val_or_next(required=True).split("|"))
+            elif name == "git-ignore": pass
+            elif name == "group-directories-first": opts.dirs_first = True; opts.dirs_last = False
+            elif name == "group-directories-last": opts.dirs_last = True; opts.dirs_first = False
+            elif name == "only-dirs": opts.only_dirs = True
+            elif name == "only-files": opts.only_files = True
+            elif name == "show-symlinks": opts.show_symlinks = True
+            elif name == "no-symlinks": opts.no_symlinks = True
+            elif name == "binary": opts.binary = True
+            elif name == "bytes": opts.bytes = True
+            elif name == "group": opts.group = True
+            elif name == "smart-group": opts.smart_group = True
+            elif name == "header": opts.header = True
+            elif name == "links": opts.links = True
+            elif name == "inode": opts.inode = True
+            elif name in ("mounts", "flags", "extended", "context", "total-size"): pass
+            elif name == "numeric": opts.numeric = True
+            elif name == "blocksize": opts.blocksize = True
+            elif name == "time": opts.time_field = val_or_next(required=True)
+            elif name == "modified": opts.time_field = "modified"
+            elif name == "accessed": opts.time_field = "accessed"
+            elif name == "created": opts.time_field = "created"
+            elif name == "changed": opts.time_field = "changed"
+            elif name == "time-style": opts.time_style = val_or_next(required=True)
+            elif name == "octal-permissions": opts.octal = True
+            elif name == "no-permissions": opts.no_permissions = True
+            elif name == "no-filesize": opts.no_filesize = True
+            elif name == "no-user": opts.no_user = True
+            elif name == "no-time": opts.no_time = True
+            elif name == "stdin": opts.stdin = True
+            elif name == "git": opts.git = True
+            elif name == "no-git": opts.no_git = True
+            elif name == "git-repos": opts.git_repos = True
+            elif name == "git-repos-no-status": opts.git_repos_no_status = True
+            else:
+                usage_error(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        shorts = arg[1:]
+        j = 0
+        while j < len(shorts):
+            c = shorts[j]
+            rest = shorts[j + 1:]
+            def short_value():
+                nonlocal i, j
+                if rest:
+                    j = len(shorts)
+                    return rest
+                v, i = need_value(argv, i, "-" + c)
+                j = len(shorts)
+                return v
+            if c == "?": sys.stdout.write(HELP); raise SystemExit(0)
+            elif c == "v": sys.stdout.write(VERSION); raise SystemExit(0)
+            elif c == "1": opts.oneline = True
+            elif c == "l": opts.long = True
+            elif c == "G": opts.grid = True
+            elif c == "x": opts.across = True
+            elif c == "R": opts.recurse = True
+            elif c == "T": opts.tree = True; opts.recurse = True
+            elif c == "F": opts.classify = set_when("-F", rest if rest else "auto"); j = len(shorts)
+            elif c == "X": pass
+            elif c == "w": opts.width = int(short_value())
+            elif c == "a": opts.all_count += 1
+            elif c == "A": opts.almost_all = True
+            elif c == "d": opts.treat_dirs = True
+            elif c == "D": opts.only_dirs = True
+            elif c == "f": opts.only_files = True
+            elif c == "L": opts.level = int(short_value())
+            elif c == "r": opts.reverse = True
+            elif c == "s": opts.sort = parse_sort(short_value())
+            elif c == "I": opts.ignore.extend(short_value().split("|"))
+            elif c == "b": opts.binary = True
+            elif c == "B": opts.bytes = True
+            elif c == "g": opts.group = True
+            elif c == "h": opts.header = True
+            elif c == "H": opts.links = True
+            elif c == "i": opts.inode = True
+            elif c == "M": pass
+            elif c == "n": opts.numeric = True
+            elif c == "O": pass
+            elif c == "S": opts.blocksize = True
+            elif c == "t": opts.time_field = short_value()
+            elif c == "m": opts.time_field = "modified"
+            elif c == "u": opts.time_field = "accessed"
+            elif c == "U": opts.time_field = "created"
+            elif c == "o": opts.octal = True
+            else: usage_error(f"Unknown argument -{c}")
+            j += 1
+        i += 1
+    if opts.stdin:
+        sep = os.environ.get("EZA_STDIN_SEPARATOR", "\n")
+        data = sys.stdin.read()
+        opts.paths.extend([p for p in data.split(sep) if p])
+    if not opts.paths:
+        opts.paths = ["."]
+    return opts
+
+
+def parse_sort(value):
+    if value not in SORT_ALIASES:
+        usage_error(f"Invalid value for option --sort: {value}")
+    return SORT_ALIASES[value]
+
+
+def natural_parts(s, casefold=True):
+    if casefold:
+        s = s.lower()
+    out = []
+    for part in re.split(r"(\d+)", s):
+        out.append((0, int(part)) if part.isdigit() else (1, part))
+    return out
+
+
+class Entry:
+    def __init__(self, path, display=None):
+        self.path = path
+        self.display = display if display is not None else path
+        self.name = os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep)) or path
+        try:
+            self.lst = os.lstat(path)
+            self.stat = os.stat(path) if os.path.islink(path) else self.lst
+            self.error = None
+        except OSError as e:
+            self.lst = None; self.stat = None; self.error = e
+
+    @property
+    def is_dir(self):
+        return self.stat is not None and stat.S_ISDIR(self.stat.st_mode)
+
+    @property
+    def is_link(self):
+        return self.lst is not None and stat.S_ISLNK(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    @property
+    def is_file(self):
+        return self.stat is not None and stat.S_ISREG(self.stat.st_mode)
+
+
+def is_hidden_name(name):
+    return name.startswith(".")
+
+
+def include_entry(e, opts):
+    name = e.name
+    if opts.all_count == 0 and not opts.almost_all and is_hidden_name(name):
+        return False
+    if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) for pat in opts.ignore):
+        return False
+    if opts.no_symlinks and e.is_link:
+        return False
+    if opts.only_dirs and not (e.is_dir or (opts.show_symlinks and e.is_link)):
+        return False
+    if opts.only_files and not (e.is_file or (opts.show_symlinks and e.is_link)):
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def read_dir(path, opts):
+    try:
+        names = os.listdir(path)
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise EzaError(f"eza: {path}: {e.strerror}\n", 2)
+    entries = []
+    if opts.all_count >= 2 and not opts.tree:
+        entries.append(Entry(os.path.join(path, "."), "."))
+        entries.append(Entry(os.path.join(path, ".."), ".."))
+    for n in names:
+        e = Entry(os.path.join(path, n), n)
+        if include_entry(e, opts):
+            entries.append(e)
+    return sort_entries(entries, opts)
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries, opts):
+    if opts.sort == "none":
+        res = list(entries)
+    else:
+        def key(e):
+            name = e.name
+            ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1][1:]
+            st = e.stat
+            if opts.sort == "Name": v = natural_parts(name, False)
+            elif opts.sort == "extension": v = (ext.lower(), natural_parts(name))
+            elif opts.sort == "Extension": v = (ext, natural_parts(name, False))
+            elif opts.sort == "size": v = (st.st_size if st else -1, natural_parts(name))
+            elif opts.sort == "type": v = (0 if e.is_dir else 1 if e.is_file else 2, natural_parts(name))
+            elif opts.sort in ("modified", "new"): v = -(st.st_mtime if st else 0)
+            elif opts.sort == "old": v = st.st_mtime if st else 0
+            elif opts.sort == "created": v = st.st_ctime if st else 0
+            elif opts.sort == "accessed": v = st.st_atime if st else 0
+            elif opts.sort == "changed": v = st.st_ctime if st else 0
+            elif opts.sort == "inode": v = st.st_ino if st else 0
+            else: v = natural_parts(name)
+            group = 0
+            if opts.dirs_first: group = 0 if e.is_dir else 1
+            if opts.dirs_last: group = 1 if e.is_dir else 0
+            return (group, v)
+        res = sorted(entries, key=key)
+    if opts.reverse:
+        res.reverse()
+    return res
+
+
+def mode_string(e):
+    st = e.stat
+    if st is None: return "-----"
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        first = "d" if e.is_dir else "l" if e.is_link else "-"
+        return first + ("a" if not e.is_dir else "-") + ("r" if not (st.st_mode & stat.S_IWRITE) else "-") + "--"
+    first = "d" if e.is_dir else "l" if e.is_link else "-"
+    bits = [(stat.S_IRUSR, "r"), (stat.S_IWUSR, "w"), (stat.S_IXUSR, "x"),
+            (stat.S_IRGRP, "r"), (stat.S_IWGRP, "w"), (stat.S_IXGRP, "x"),
+            (stat.S_IROTH, "r"), (stat.S_IWOTH, "w"), (stat.S_IXOTH, "x")]
+    return first + "".join(ch if st.st_mode & bit else "-" for bit, ch in bits)
+
+
+def file_size(e, opts):
+    if e.is_dir:
+        return "-"
+    size = e.stat.st_size if e.stat else 0
+    if opts.bytes:
+        return str(size)
+    if opts.binary or size < 1000:
+        return str(size)
+    units = ["", "k", "M", "G", "T"]
+    n = float(size); u = 0
+    while n >= 1000 and u < len(units) - 1:
+        n /= 1000; u += 1
+    return f"{n:.1f}{units[u]}" if n < 10 else f"{n:.0f}{units[u]}"
+
+
+def timestamp(e, opts):
+    st = e.stat
+    if st is None: return "-"
+    ts = st.st_mtime
+    if opts.time_field == "accessed": ts = st.st_atime
+    elif opts.time_field in ("created", "changed"): ts = st.st_ctime
+    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
+    if opts.time_style == "iso": return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    if opts.time_style == "long-iso": return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if opts.time_style == "full-iso": return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f %z").strip()
+    if opts.time_style == "relative":
+        delta = int(time.time() - ts)
+        if abs(delta) < 60: return "now"
+        if delta > 0:
+            for unit, sec in (("year",31536000),("month",2592000),("week",604800),("day",86400),("hour",3600),("minute",60)):
+                if delta >= sec:
+                    n = delta // sec; return f"{n} {unit}{'' if n == 1 else 's'} ago"
+        return "now"
+    if opts.time_style.startswith("+"):
+        return dt.strftime(opts.time_style[1:])
+    return dt.strftime("%e %b %H:%M").replace(" 0", "  ")
+
+
+def icon_for(e, opts):
+    if opts.icons != "always":
+        return ""
+    if e.is_dir: return " "
+    return ICON_EXT.get(os.path.splitext(e.name)[1].lower(), " ")
+
+
+def classify(e, opts):
+    if opts.classify == "never" or opts.classify == "auto":
+        return ""
+    if e.is_dir: return "/"
+    if e.is_link: return "@"
+    if e.stat and (e.stat.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR): return "*"
+    return ""
+
+
+def shown_name(e, opts):
+    name = e.display
+    if opts.absolute and name not in (".", ".."):
+        name = os.path.abspath(e.path)
+    if not opts.no_quotes and name.startswith(" "):
+        name = "'" + name + "'"
+    s = icon_for(e, opts) + name + classify(e, opts)
+    if e.is_link and not opts.long:
+        try:
+            target = os.readlink(e.path)
+            s += " -> " + target
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    if opts.hyperlink:
+        uri = "file:///" + os.path.abspath(e.path).replace(os.sep, "/")
+        s = f"\033]8;;{uri}\033\\{s}\033]8;;\033\\"
+    return s
+
+
+def long_line(e, opts, widths):
+    cols = []
+    if opts.inode:
+        cols.append(str(e.stat.st_ino if e.stat else 0).rjust(widths.get("inode", 0)))
+    if not opts.no_permissions:
+        cols.append((oct(e.stat.st_mode & 0o777)[2:].zfill(3) if opts.octal and e.stat else mode_string(e)).rjust(widths.get("mode", 0)))
+    if opts.links:
+        cols.append(str(getattr(e.stat, "st_nlink", 1) if e.stat else 1).rjust(widths.get("links", 0)))
+    if opts.blocksize:
+        blocks = getattr(e.stat, "st_blocks", 0) if e.stat else 0
+        cols.append(str(blocks).rjust(widths.get("blocks", 0)))
+    if not opts.no_filesize:
+        cols.append(file_size(e, opts).rjust(widths.get("size", 0)))
+    if not opts.no_time:
+        cols.append(timestamp(e, opts).rjust(widths.get("time", 0)))
+    if opts.group:
+        cols.append("-".rjust(widths.get("group", 0)))
+    cols.append(shown_name(e, opts))
+    return " ".join(cols)
+
+
+def render_long(entries, opts):
+    widths = {"inode": 0, "mode": 0, "links": 0, "blocks": 0, "size": 0, "time": 0, "group": 0}
+    vals = []
+    for e in entries:
+        row = {"inode": str(e.stat.st_ino if e.stat else 0), "mode": oct(e.stat.st_mode & 0o777)[2:].zfill(3) if opts.octal and e.stat else mode_string(e),
+               "links": str(getattr(e.stat, "st_nlink", 1) if e.stat else 1), "blocks": str(getattr(e.stat, "st_blocks", 0) if e.stat else 0),
+               "size": file_size(e, opts), "time": timestamp(e, opts), "group": "-"}
+        vals.append(row)
+        for k, v in row.items(): widths[k] = max(widths[k], len(v))
+    out = []
+    if opts.header:
+        heads = []
+        if opts.inode: heads.append("inode".rjust(widths["inode"]))
+        if not opts.no_permissions: heads.append(("permissions" if not opts.octal else "octal").rjust(widths["mode"]))
+        if opts.links: heads.append("links".rjust(widths["links"]))
+        if opts.blocksize: heads.append("blocks".rjust(widths["blocks"]))
+        if not opts.no_filesize: heads.append("size".rjust(widths["size"]))
+        if not opts.no_time: heads.append("date".rjust(widths["time"]))
+        heads.append("name")
+        out.append(" ".join(heads))
+    out.extend(long_line(e, opts, widths) for e in entries)
+    return out
+
+
+def render_grid(entries, opts):
+    names = [shown_name(e, opts) for e in entries]
+    if opts.oneline or not opts.grid:
+        return names
+    width = opts.width or 80
+    if not names: return []
+    colw = max(len(strip_ansi(n)) for n in names) + 2
+    cols = max(1, width // colw)
+    lines = []
+    if opts.across:
+        for i in range(0, len(names), cols):
+            lines.append("".join(n.ljust(colw) for n in names[i:i + cols]).rstrip())
+    else:
+        rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
+        for r in range(rows):
+            parts = []
+            for c in range(cols):
+                idx = c * rows + r
+                if idx < len(names): parts.append(names[idx].ljust(colw))
+            lines.append("".join(parts).rstrip())
+    return lines
+
+
+def strip_ansi(s):
+    return re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", s)
+
+
+def render_tree(root, opts, depth=0, prefix="", is_last=True, name=None):
+    e = Entry(root, name if name is not None else root)
+    lines = []
+    label = shown_name(e, opts)
+    if depth == 0:
+        lines.append(label)
+    else:
+        lines.append(prefix + ("└── " if is_last else "├── ") + label)
+    if not e.is_dir:
+        return lines
+    if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+        return lines
+    try:
+        children = read_dir(root, opts)
+    except EzaError as err:
+        sys.stderr.write(str(err)); return lines
+    next_prefix = prefix + ("    " if is_last else "│   ") if depth else ""
+    for i, child in enumerate(children):

+    def is_dir(self):

+
+    def is_file(self):
+        return stat.S_ISREG(self.st.st_mode) if self.is_link() else stat.S_ISREG(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    def file_type_order(self):
+        if self.is_dir(): return 0
+        if self.is_file(): return 1

+class EzaError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, msg, status=3):
+        super().__init__(msg)
+        self.status = status
+
+
+def err_unknown(flag):
+    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument {flag}")
+
+
+def add_flag(opts, name, val=None):
+    opts.flags.append(name)
+    if val is not None:
+        opts.values[name] = val
+
+
+def parse(argv):
+    opts = Opts()
+    i = 0
+    parsing = True
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if not parsing:
+            opts.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            parsing = False; i += 1; continue
+        if arg.startswith("--") and arg != "--":
+            raw = arg[2:]
+            name, eq, value = raw.partition("=")
+            if name not in ALL_LONG:
+                err_unknown("--" + name)
+            tv = TAKES_VALUE.get(name, "forbid")
+            if tv == "forbid":
+                if eq:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Option --{name} doesn't allow an argument")
+                add_flag(opts, name)
+            elif tv == "need":
+                if eq:
+                    value = value
+                else:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise EzaError(f"Option --{name} requires an argument")
+                    value = argv[i]
+                add_flag(opts, name, value)
+            else:
+                if eq:
+                    val = value
+                elif i + 1 < len(argv) and argv[i + 1] in OPTIONAL_VALUES.get(name, set()):
+                    i += 1; val = argv[i]
+                else:
+                    val = OPTIONAL_DEFAULTS[name]
+                add_flag(opts, name, val)
+            i += 1; continue
+        if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
+            cluster = arg[1:]
+            if "=" in cluster:
+                before, value = cluster.split("=", 1)
+                chars = list(before)
+                if not chars:
+                    opts.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+                for ch in chars[:-1]:
+                    if ch not in SHORT_TO_LONG: err_unknown("-" + ch)
+                    name = SHORT_TO_LONG[ch]
+                    if TAKES_VALUE.get(name) == "need":
+                        raise EzaError(f"Option -{ch} requires an argument")
+                    add_flag(opts, name, OPTIONAL_DEFAULTS.get(name) if TAKES_VALUE.get(name) == "optional" else None)
+                ch = chars[-1]
+                if ch not in SHORT_TO_LONG: err_unknown("-" + ch)
+                name = SHORT_TO_LONG[ch]
+                if TAKES_VALUE.get(name) == "forbid":
+                    raise EzaError(f"Option -{ch} doesn't allow an argument")
+                add_flag(opts, name, value)
+            else:
+                j = 0
+                while j < len(cluster):
+                    ch = cluster[j]
+                    if ch not in SHORT_TO_LONG: err_unknown("-" + ch)
+                    name = SHORT_TO_LONG[ch]
+                    tv = TAKES_VALUE.get(name, "forbid")
+                    if tv == "need":
+                        rest = cluster[j + 1:]
+                        if rest:
+                            val = rest
+                        else:
+                            i += 1
+                            if i >= len(argv):
+                                raise EzaError(f"Option -{ch} requires an argument")
+                            val = argv[i]
+                        add_flag(opts, name, val)
+                        break
+                    if tv == "optional":
+                        rest = cluster[j + 1:]
+                        if rest:
+                            val = rest
+                            add_flag(opts, name, val)
+                            break
+                        elif i + 1 < len(argv) and argv[i + 1] in OPTIONAL_VALUES.get(name, set()):
+                            i += 1; add_flag(opts, name, argv[i])
+                        else:
+                            add_flag(opts, name, OPTIONAL_DEFAULTS[name])
+                    else:
+                        add_flag(opts, name)
+                    j += 1
+            i += 1; continue
+        opts.paths.append(arg); i += 1
+    finish_opts(opts)
+    return opts
+
+
+def has(opts, name):
+    return name in opts.flags
+
+
+def last_mode(opts):
+    m = None
+    for f in opts.flags:
+        if f in ("oneline", "long", "grid", "tree"):
+            m = f
+    return m
+
+
+def finish_opts(o):
+    o.all_count = sum(1 for f in o.flags if f == "all")
+    if has(o, "almost-all") and o.all_count == 0:
+        o.all_count = 1
+    mode = last_mode(o)
+    o.long = has(o, "long") and mode not in ("oneline",)
+    o.tree = mode == "tree"
+    o.recurse = has(o, "recurse") or o.tree
+    if mode == "oneline" or (not mode and not sys.stdout.isatty()):
+        o.mode = "lines"
+    elif o.long:
+        o.mode = "long"
+    elif o.tree:
+        o.mode = "tree"
+    else:
+        o.mode = "grid"
+    if "level" in o.values:
+        try: o.level = int(o.values["level"])
+        except ValueError as e: raise EzaError(f"Failed to parse number '{o.values['level']}': {e}")
+    if "width" in o.values:
+        try: o.width = int(o.values["width"])
+        except ValueError as e: raise EzaError(f"Failed to parse number '{o.values['width']}': {e}")
+    if "sort" in o.values:
+        val = o.values["sort"]
+        if val not in SORT_MAP:
+            raise EzaError(f"Option --sort (-s) has no \"{val}\" setting (choices: name, Name, size, extension, Extension, modified, changed, accessed, created, inode, type, none)")
+        o.sort = SORT_MAP[val]
+    o.reverse = has(o, "reverse")
+    o.dirs_first = has(o, "group-directories-first")
+    o.dirs_last = has(o, "group-directories-last")
+    o.only_dirs = has(o, "only-dirs")
+    o.only_files = has(o, "only-files")
+    o.no_symlinks = has(o, "no-symlinks")
+    o.show_symlinks = has(o, "show-symlinks")
+    o.treat_dirs = has(o, "treat-dirs-as-files") or has(o, "list-dirs")
+    o.ignore = o.values.get("ignore-glob", "").split("|") if "ignore-glob" in o.values else []
+    o.classify = o.values.get("classify", "never")
+    o.icons = o.values.get("icons", "never")
+    o.absolute = o.values.get("absolute", "off")
+    o.no_perms = has(o, "no-permissions")
+    o.no_size = has(o, "no-filesize")
+    o.no_user = has(o, "no-user")
+    o.no_time = has(o, "no-time")
+    o.header = has(o, "header")
+    o.binary = has(o, "binary") and not has(o, "bytes")
+    o.bytes_ = has(o, "bytes")
+    o.links = has(o, "links")
+    o.inode = has(o, "inode")
+    o.group = has(o, "group")
+    o.flags_col = has(o, "flags")
+    o.stdin = has(o, "stdin")
+    fields = []
+    if "time" in o.values:
+        v = o.values["time"]
+        aliases = {"mod": "modified", "modified": "modified", "ch": "changed", "changed": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "accessed": "accessed", "cr": "created", "created": "created"}
+        if v not in aliases:
+            raise EzaError(f"Option --time (-t) has no \"{v}\" setting")
+        fields = [aliases[v]]
+    else:
+        for n in ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created"):
+            if has(o, n): fields.append(n)
+    o.time_fields = [] if o.no_time else (fields or ["modified"])
+    o.time_style = o.values.get("time-style", os.environ.get("TIME_STYLE", "default"))
+

+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display_path: Path
+    parent: Path | None = None
+    st: object | None = None
+    lst: object | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        self.lst = os.lstat(self.path)
+        try:
+            self.st = os.stat(self.path)
+        except OSError:
+            self.st = self.lst
+
+    @property
+    def name(self):
+        return self.display_path.name if self.parent is not None else str(self.display_path)
+
+    def is_link(self):
+        return stat.S_ISLNK(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    def is_dir(self):
+        return stat.S_ISDIR(self.st.st_mode) if self.is_link() else stat.S_ISDIR(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    def is_file(self):
+        return stat.S_ISREG(self.st.st_mode) if self.is_link() else stat.S_ISREG(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    def file_type_order(self):
+        if self.is_dir(): return 0
+        if self.is_file(): return 1
+        if self.is_link(): return 2
+        return 7
+
+
+def filetime(e, field):
+    if field == "accessed": return e.st.st_atime
+    if field == "created": return getattr(e.st, "st_birthtime", e.st.st_ctime)
+    if field == "changed": return e.st.st_ctime
+    return e.st.st_mtime
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries, o):
+    def ext(n):
+        b = n.name
+        return b.rsplit(".", 1)[1] if "." in b and not b.endswith(".") else ""
+    def key(e):
+        name = e.name
+        low = name.lower()
+        if o.sort in ("name", ".name"): k = (low, name)
+        elif o.sort in ("Name", ".Name"): k = (name,)
+        elif o.sort == "size": k = (0 if e.is_dir() else e.st.st_size, low)
+        elif o.sort in ("ext", "Ext"): k = (ext(e) if o.sort == "Ext" else ext(e).lower(), low)
+        elif o.sort == "modified": k = (filetime(e, "modified"), low)
+        elif o.sort == "age": k = (-filetime(e, "modified"), low)
+        elif o.sort in ("changed", "accessed", "created"): k = (filetime(e, o.sort), low)
+        elif o.sort == "inode": k = (getattr(e.st, "st_ino", 0), low)
+        elif o.sort == "type": k = (e.file_type_order(), low)
+        else: k = (0,)
+        if o.dirs_first: return (0 if e.is_dir() else 1, k)
+        if o.dirs_last: return (1 if e.is_dir() else 0, k)
+        return k
+    if o.sort != "none" or o.dirs_first or o.dirs_last:
+        entries.sort(key=key)
+    if o.reverse:
+        entries.reverse()
+
+
+def visible(name, o):
+    if name in (".", ".."):
+        return o.all_count >= 2
+    if name.startswith("."):
+        return o.all_count >= 1
+    return True
+
+
+def filtered(e, o, child=True):
+    n = e.display_path.name
+    if not visible(n, o): return True
+    if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(n, pat) for pat in o.ignore if pat): return True
+    if o.no_symlinks and e.is_link(): return True
+    if o.only_dirs and not (e.is_dir() or (e.is_link() and o.show_symlinks)): return True
+    if o.only_files and not (e.is_file() or (e.is_link() and o.show_symlinks)): return True
+    return False
+
+
+def classify(e, o):
+    if o.classify == "never" or (o.classify == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty()): return ""
+    if e.is_dir(): return "/"
+    if e.is_link(): return "@"
+    if os.name != "nt" and e.st.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR: return "*"
+    return ""
+
+
+def quote_name(s):
+    if " " in s or "\t" in s:
+        return '"' + s + '"' if "'" in s else "'" + s + "'"
+    return s
+
+
+def render_name(e, o):
+    p = e.path.resolve() if o.absolute in ("on", "follow") else e.display_path
+    s = str(p) if e.parent is None and o.absolute == "off" else (str(p) if o.absolute != "off" else e.name)
+    s = quote_name(s)
+    if e.is_link():
+        try:
+            target = os.readlink(e.path)
+            s += " -> " + target
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return s + classify(e, o)
+
+
+def mode_string(e):
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        first = "d" if e.is_dir() else ("l" if e.is_link() else "-")
+        readonly = not os.access(e.path, os.W_OK)
+        hidden = e.path.name.startswith(".")
+        return first + ("r" if readonly else "a") + ("h" if hidden else "-") + "--"
+    m = e.lst.st_mode
+    first = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(m) else ("l" if stat.S_ISLNK(m) else "-")
+    bits = ""
+    for who in ((stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)):
+        bits += "r" if m & who[0] else "-"
+        bits += "w" if m & who[1] else "-"
+        bits += "x" if m & who[2] else "-"
+    return first + bits
+
+
+def size_string(e, o):
+    if e.is_dir(): return "-"
+    size = e.st.st_size
+    if o.bytes_: return str(size)
+    base = 1024 if o.binary else 1000
+    units = ["", "K", "M", "G", "T"] if o.binary else ["", "k", "M", "G", "T"]
+    n = float(size); u = 0
+    while n >= base and u < len(units) - 1:
+        n /= base; u += 1
+    if u == 0: return str(size)
+    if n < 10: return f"{n:.1f}{units[u]}"
+    return f"{n:.0f}{units[u]}"
+
+
+def time_string(e, field, style):
+    t = datetime.fromtimestamp(filetime(e, field))
+    now = datetime.now()
+    if style == "long-iso": return t.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
+    if style == "full-iso": return t.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f %z")
+    if style == "iso": return t.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M") if t.year == now.year else t.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+    if style == "relative":
+        secs = max(0, int(time.time() - filetime(e, field)))
+        if secs < 60: return "now"
+        if secs < 3600: return f"{secs//60}m"
+        if secs < 86400: return f"{secs//3600}h"
+        return f"{secs//86400}d"
+    return t.strftime("%d %b %H:%M" if t.year == now.year else "%d %b  %Y").lstrip("0")
+
+
+def long_rows(entries, o):
+    cols = []
+    if not o.no_perms: cols.append(("Mode", lambda e: mode_string(e), "left"))
+    if o.inode: cols.append(("inode", lambda e: str(getattr(e.st, "st_ino", 0)), "right"))
+    if o.links: cols.append(("Links", lambda e: str(getattr(e.st, "st_nlink", 1)), "right"))
+    if not o.no_size: cols.append(("Size", lambda e: size_string(e, o), "right"))
+    if not o.no_user: cols.append(("User", lambda e: os.environ.get("USERNAME") or os.environ.get("USER") or "-", "left"))
+    if o.group: cols.append(("Group", lambda e: "-", "left"))
+    if o.flags_col: cols.append(("Flags", lambda e: "-", "left"))
+    for field in o.time_fields:
+        title = {"modified": "Date Modified", "changed": "Date Changed", "accessed": "Date Accessed", "created": "Date Created"}[field]
+        cols.append((title, lambda e, f=field: time_string(e, f, o.time_style), "left"))
+    data = [[fn(e) for _, fn, _ in cols] + [render_name(e, o)] for e in entries]
+    widths = [len(t) for t, _, _ in cols]
+    for row in data:
+        for i, cell in enumerate(row[:-1]): widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(cell))
+    out = []
+    if o.header:
+        out.append(" ".join((t.rjust(widths[i]) if cols[i][2] == "right" else t.ljust(widths[i])) for i, (t, _, _) in enumerate(cols)) + (" " if cols else "") + "Name")
+    for row in data:
+        left = []
+        for i, cell in enumerate(row[:-1]):
+            left.append(cell.rjust(widths[i]) if cols[i][2] == "right" else cell.ljust(widths[i]))
+        out.append((" ".join(left) + (" " if left else "") + row[-1]).rstrip())
+    return out
+
+
+def grid_lines(entries, o):
+    names = [render_name(e, o) for e in entries]
+    if not names: return []
+    width = o.width or int(os.environ.get("COLUMNS", "0") or 0) or get_terminal_size((80, 20)).columns
+    maxw = max(len(n) for n in names) + 2
+    cols = max(1, width // maxw)
+    rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
+    out = []
+    across = has(o, "across")
+    for r in range(rows):
+        line = []
+        for c in range(cols):
+            idx = r * cols + c if across else c * rows + r
+            if idx < len(names):
+                s = names[idx]
+                line.append(s if c == cols - 1 or (idx + rows >= len(names) and not across) else s.ljust(maxw))
+        out.append("".join(line).rstrip())
+    return out
+
+
+def read_dir(path, o):
+    entries = []
+    if o.all_count >= 2:
+        for special in (".", ".."):
+            p = path / special
+            try: entries.append(Entry(p, Path(special), path))
+            except OSError: pass
+    for child in path.iterdir():
+        try:
+            e = Entry(child, child, path)
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        if not filtered(e, o): entries.append(e)
+    sort_entries(entries, o)
+    return entries
+
+
+def print_entries(entries, o):
+    if o.mode == "long": lines = long_rows(entries, o)
+    elif o.mode == "grid": lines = grid_lines(entries, o)
+    else: lines = [render_name(e, o) for e in entries]
+    for line in lines: print(line)
+
+
+def tree(path, o, prefix="", depth=0):
+    if depth == 0:
+        print(render_name(Entry(path, path), o))
+    if o.level is not None and depth >= o.level: return
+    try: children = read_dir(path, o)
+    except OSError as e:
+        print(f"{path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr); return
+    for i, e in enumerate(children):
+        last = i == len(children) - 1
+        print(prefix + ("└── " if last else "├── ") + render_name(e, o))
+        if e.is_dir() and (not e.is_link() or has(o, "follow-symlinks")):
+            tree(e.path, o, prefix + ("    " if last else "│   "), depth + 1)
+
+
+def run(o):
+    if o.stdin and not o.paths:
+        sep = os.environ.get("EZA_STDIN_SEPARATOR") or os.environ.get("EXA_STDIN_SEPARATOR") or "\n"
+        o.paths = [p for p in sys.stdin.read().split(sep) if p]
+    if not o.paths: o.paths = ["."]
+    files, dirs, status = [], [], 0
+    for ptxt in o.paths:
+        p = Path(ptxt)
+        try:
+            e = Entry(p, p)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print(f'"{ptxt}": {exc}', file=sys.stderr)
+            status = 2; continue
